title: Prospecting the protein design landscape.
authors: Riccabona, Jakob R; Stonig, Katharina T; Meiler, Jens; Schoeder, Clara T; Fernandez-Quintero, Monica L
one_liner_zh: 该综述概述了深度学习驱动的蛋白质设计流程，并强调集成方法提升设计成功率，虽为综述但紧扣蛋白质结构设计核心问题，方法上涉及生成式AI，具有参考价值。
abstract: Generative AI has driven remarkable breakthroughs in protein design, enabling the rapid, computationally guided creation of high-affinity binders against diverse targets. While remarkable experimental success has been demonstrated, the confidence metrics used to filter and evaluate designs remain optimized for static protein interfaces and can fail when applied to underrepresented or conformationally complex targets. In this review, we outline the current landscape of deep learning-driven protein design pipelines, discuss tailored applications in peptide, small molecule, binder, vaccine, and antibody design, and argue that the integration of ensemble-based methods represents a promising avenue for improving design success rates. Beyond single target binder design, we further highlight emerging strategies that expand the functional scope of designed proteins, including fold-switching scaffolds and molecular glues realized through engineered cyclic peptides, which enable context-dependent control of protein-protein interaction networks. Together, these advances position de novo protein design as a broadly applicable technology platform at the intersection of structural biology, biophysics, and molecular medicine.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能推动了蛋白质设计的显著突破，能够快速、计算引导地创建针对多种靶标的高亲和力结合剂。尽管已展示出显著的实验成功，但用于筛选和评估设计的置信度指标仍针对静态蛋白质界面进行优化，在应用于代表性不足或构象复杂的靶标时可能失效。在本综述中，我们概述了当前深度学习驱动的蛋白质设计流程的格局，讨论了在肽、小分子、结合剂、疫苗和抗体设计中的定制应用，并主张集成基于集合的方法代表了一种提高设计成功率的可行途径。超越单一靶标结合剂设计，我们进一步强调了扩展设计蛋白质功能范围的新兴策略，包括通过工程化环肽实现的折叠转换支架和分子胶，这些策略能够实现蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络的上下文依赖性控制。总体而言，这些进展将从头蛋白质设计定位为结构生物学、生物物理学和分子医学交叉领域的一项广泛应用的技术平台。
